review_method: Actual direct tools.view_image(detail=original) observations of all unique final images; unchanged image hashes inherit their direct initial observation. No contact sheets or image modifications.
scope: Raster appearance, legibility, canvas clipping, spacing, chart units, captions and visible null labels

Causal rule guides: b-close availability; separate later arming/reclaim; next eligible open; submitted limit rounding/trade-through; initial percentage stop and surviving-entry-candle reset; timed exit
Long/short and upper-first/lower-first symmetry; reversal original direction; empirical candidate-versus-baseline no-fill attribution
Original-position/loss-known labels visible in empirical examples; price recovery is separate from actual account financial recovery
Additional annual paired, actual-fill year/session, participation, transition and recovery-time charts

resolved_initial_findings.resolution: Final sensitivity text is inside both long and short boxes.
Lower-first heading is separated from the preceding shared-execution box.
All 20 empirical figures label observed path span and actual signal/fill time; footer says observed span is not candidate holding time; no-fill cases explicitly show baseline fill.
All empirical captions identify original upper-first/lower-first direction; reversal candidate direction is visibly opposite.
All eight right endpoint dates/dollar labels are end-anchored within the canvas.

interpretation_notes: Illustrative guide candles use explicitly normalized geometry and are not observed prices or exact stop-distance/tick-scale evidence.
Empirical paths use unadjusted GC closes with per-panel price scale, saved H/M/L and initial/reset stops; slipped fills need not lie on the close curve.
Saved candidate closed P&L, standardized fills and price-recovery timing do not assert real account returns.

The adjacent time-recovery-anchor paragraph explicitly identifies mean delay conditional on known recovery timing, its first-known-breach anchor, timing bounds and separate unknown/exposure denominators. It distinguishes price timing from survival probability, executed targets and financial recovery. No caption revision is required.
limitations: Manual appearance judgment is not automated scientific verification. Numeric cells, source CSV equality, earliest-example selection and exact SVG geometry are covered by the separate independent publication receipt.
Browser layout, navigation, console and download interaction checks are performed separately by the root agent.
